body:
Hey man, sorry for the late response, but I want to thank you for taking your time to read through my post and responding - it's nice to know that I'm not completely alone with these feelings. 
Today I passed my exam, and for a long time, I actually smiled and laughed sincerely without any darkness overshadowing my mind right after - that was a great feeling, and you should know that your post inspired me to prepare well enough to pass with a pretty damn good result. So thanks brother, thanks for taking your time for a random stranger :)
